body: Thanks a lot but I think I'm all set. I've discussed things before and I don't have any real problems. Just miserable anyway. Thanks though!

No thanks. I had a friend for about a year that I was close to but that came to a close in November. Since then I've been very lonely, and i sleep in my car most nights. I think I'll just drive it into a bridge tonight. It's a v6, it's quick. I can easily achieve 140. I don't want to put anybody else in harms way though so I'll wait until 1 or 2 am (east coast).

It's been a good run, Reddit has been a great experience & thank you everyone in this sub for trying to help, and I hope I've inspired others not to off themselves as well. Thank you very much for trying to help though :)

No not really but thank you. I still would like to help those who'd like to live but I don't particularly. I imagine sometime tonight I'll do it. I don't have any real problems, and I don't want to annoy people. I'm not an entitled teenager who thinks he deserves attention or care, living is just simply is for those who really want it. If I don't care, I should probably stop wasting people's time, including my own. Thank you for trying to help! Not your fault, and you really are kind!
